title: Rosemary Beach: Bon Temps in Rosemary Beach – Rosemary Beach®
meta_description: Rosemary Beach: Bon Temps in Rosemary Beach. Enter Bon Temps and the fun begins on the ground floor with a bunk room for 4 that gives kids not just beds but an entire living area to call their own! Their room leads out the deck and pool area, and you can bet the kids will be using the pool to the fullest! Also on the ground floor are two king bedroom suites – someone has to keep an eye on the kids, right? - along with two en suite bathrooms, one with a walk-in shower stall and the other with a shower/bath combo.
description_expanded:
Property includes dedicated Rosemary Beach® community Beach Access via 9 Private Beach Walkovers. Beach chair service available for an additional cost through RBPOA Beach Service. Complimentary access to Rosemary Beach® Fitness and complimentary court time at Rosemary Beach® Racquet Club also included.

Enter Bon Temps and the fun begins on the ground floor with a bunk room for 4 that gives kids not just beds but an entire living area to call their own! Their room leads out the deck and pool area, and you can bet the kids will be using the pool to the fullest! Also on the ground floor are two king bedroom suites – someone has to keep an eye on the kids, right? - along with two en suite bathrooms, one with a walk-in shower stall and the other with a shower/bath combo. A hall bath is easily accessible for the bunk room and a separate laundry room is also on the ground floor. The pool area is accessible from the hall on the ground floor, the bunk room and one of the king suites.

As you head up the stairs, the adults in the group will be delighted by the incredible open living area, with space for everyone! The fabrics, colors and honey wood flooring and beams combine for a warm and welcoming environment. Plenty of chairs and seating for everyone to find their own nook, whether it’s to read a book, chat or watch the 48” Smart TV. The fully-equipped kitchen seats 4 at the breakfast bar, along with seating for 8 at the dining table.

And how could we forget the amazing 2nd-floor balcony! Extending the interior living area is a covered south-facing balcony, with a dining table and chairs for 6, plus a bench and chairs to seat another 4 comfortably. Also on the second floor is an additional king suite, with an en suite bathroom and a walk-in shower stall. The second floor also has a handy powder room.

The third floor has a lovely, sunlit double queen bedroom, with a full en suite bathroom with a shower stall. A comfy chair and ottoman nestled by the window is the perfect spot to curl up with a good book in the sunshine and get away from it all.

Bon Temps has everything you need for a fabulous, relaxing vacation! The beach, plus all the dining, shopping and amenities Rosemary Beach has to offer are just steps away! We look forward to welcoming you!

Add Beau Soleil Carriage House for additional space.

Seven Night, Saturday to Saturday rental required for Spring Break and Summer

Pool can be heated October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee
